question.problem:
Which of the following vector spaces has a dimension of $49?$

I. ${R}_{7}[t]$, the vector space of all polynomials in the variable $t$ of degree at most $7$

II. ${R}^{7}$

III. ${\text{M}}_{7}(R),$ the vector space of all $7\times 7$ matrices over $R$

current_example.problem:
Which of the following vector spaces has a dimension of $9?$

I. $\mathbb{R}^8$

II. $\mathbb{R}_8[t]$, the vector space of all polynomials in the variable $t$ of degree at most $8$

III. $\text{M}_{3}(\mathbb{R}),$ the vector space of all $3 \times 3$ matrices over $\mathbb{R}$
current_example.worked_solution:
Let's examine each of the vector spaces in turn.

I. Recall that $\textrm{dim}(\mathbb{R}^n)=n.$ Therefore, 

  $$
  \textrm{dim}(\mathbb{R}^8)=8\neq 9.\quad {\color{red}{\times}}
  $$

II. Recall that $\textrm{dim}(\mathbb{R}_{n}[t])=n+1.$ Therefore, 

  $$
  \textrm{dim}(\mathbb{R}_{8}[t])=8+1=9.\quad {\color{green}{\checkmark}}
  $$

III. Recall that $\textrm{dim}(\text{M}_{n}(\mathbb{R}))=n^2.$ Therefore, 

  $$
  \text{dim}(\text{M}_{3}(\mathbb{R}))=3^2=9.\quad {\color{green}{\checkmark}}
  $$

Hence, the correct answer is "II and III only."
